evaluation.label: Evaluation (Disambiguation & Context Overload)
evaluation.description: Results return too many identical or ungrounded photos without contextual metadata, making it impossible to identify the target memory.

sample_quotes.quote: He recognizes me as three different people and I can't join my photos.
Google Photos is merging random photos into the same face, like my grandpa with my baby cousin.
the new update removed all the face groups I had, now I can't even find the people I want in the pictures

expression.label: Expression (Query Articulation Gap)
expression.description: User cannot articulate partial memories (approximate date, emotional moment, visual detail) into a searchable text query.

sample_quotes.quote: How can I easily find photos or videos that I most recently backed up, even if their time stamp (when they were taken) is from years ago?
I remember that I was standing there and hold a matchbox which is bigger in size
you can search by face in the USA but not Europe

interpretation.label: Interpretation (Semantic & Intent Failure)
interpretation.description: Search engine fails to parse relative dates, entities, or compositional criteria, or Ask Photos hallucinates/returns clutter.

sample_quotes.quote: if I search Google Photos for 'me', the top hit is a frog
all of these results in videos that are under 60 seconds in the list to scroll
it shows all kinds of garbage/nonsense, instead of the requested images by name
